We have a component called Text It's simple. ``` @ChildContent ``` When we use it, for example, in an `if` block. ``` @if (!string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(SubTitle)) { @SubTitle } ``` We get a compilation error `Error RZ1023 : "" and "" tags cannot contain attributes` But if we wrap this component, for example, in a div, or use the full class name, everything is ok. ``` @if (!string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(SubTitle)) {
@SubTitle

The error message "Error RZ1023: '<text>' and '</text>' tags cannot contain attributes" clearly indicates that Blazor is interpreting the custom component as the built-in text tag. The solution (using the full class name or wrapping in another element) can be verified through code analysis without needing to build or run the code. This is a known behavior in Blazor where component names that match HTML elements or built-in Blazor elements can cause conflicts.
